additional_info.subject: RE: ID0368878-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / PN 312569868/10] OCPP communication issue CRM:00921000973
additional_info.body:
Hello Yacine,
Greetings of the day,
We have checked the router settings remotely and we need clarification on a few points:
Please confirm the APN settings of this connection, right now it is updated as "bicsapn".
Please let us know whether any wired connection is given to router 2, Failover is enable for wired network.
As you mentioned that this site has better connectivity, please let us know which network is best at this location. As of now network mode is selected to Auto and SIM is in roaming,
Awaiting your response.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Saurav
